title: Custom Fighting music
description: Adds custom fighting music mainly for dueling servers to listen to play music to thier players
body:
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x-green?style=for-the-badge)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-All%20Rights%20Reserved-darkred?style=for-the-badge)

Custom Fighting Music Resource Pack

The Custom Fighting Music resource pack adds a collection of custom battle tracks designed to enhance combat, PvP, and boss fight experiences on your server. Each track is built to trigger intense atmosphere during fights, making gameplay more immersive and dynamic.

To use the custom music in-game, players can play specific tracks using the Minecraft command:


```
/playsound minecraft:custommusic.(soundid) master @s
```


**Replace (soundid) with the ID of the desired music track included in the pack (for example: Chaoscunstruct, music2, etc.).**

This system allows server owners to easily expand and manage multiple combat music tracks while giving players a smooth way to trigger them during gameplay.

**Currently being used in the minecraft server called "Pinnacle", Will be on modrinth soon.**


<details>
<summary>For Server Owners</summary>

If you're using this resource pack on a server, I recommend using [ForcePack](https://modrinth.com/plugin/forcepack) to automatically send the resource pack to players when they join. You can also configure it to be optional if you prefer.

In the ForcePack configuration, use the following direct download link as the resource pack URL:



```
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DbRJMVrl/versions/sAWXvTxb/CustomFightingMusic.zip?mr_download_reason=standalone
```

</details>
